content: Gotify (gotify.net/docs + search, fetched 2026-08): self-hosted Go server, multi-user, web UI + Android app. Application=channel created in WebUI/REST; app token (A-prefix 15 chars, shown once since v3) authenticates sending via POST /message (X-Gotify-Key header or ?token=) with title, message (required), priority (int 0-10), extras. extras: client::notification (Android sound/vibration/LED), client::display contentType text/markdown. Receiving: WebSocket /stream/websocket with client token (C-prefix); web UI renders markdown by default. Messages persist in DB until manually deleted (per-app views); auto-cleanup historically via external cron calling delete API. Strictly one-way; no reply, no per-message buttons.
